description: This file defines the ProviderFilterDecorator class in the Drupal migrate module, implementing plugin discovery filtering based on provider existence.

classes.name: ProviderFilterDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for filtering plugin definitions based on provider existence in Drupal's migration module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a decorated discovery object and a provider existence callback.

methods.name: filterDefinitions
methods.description: Static method to filter plugin definitions, ensuring providers exist or are in a predefined list.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns filtered plugin definitions by delegating to the decorated object's getDefinitions method.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to pass through calls to the decorated object.
